bug.title: Appeal overturn can list an unmoderated paper, restore stale state, and be pre-empted by a forged marker; panel seed is grindable
bug.symptoms: appeals/votes.py restores the target's prior state by emitting a moderation decision with action _RESTORE_ACTIONS.get(prior, "list"): when the prior state was "moderation" (or anything unmapped) the restoration LISTS the version, skipping moderation entirely The restoration runs even when the appealed decision is no longer the newest state-setting decision on the target (a moderator acted since), overwriting newer state; the retry path in cast_vote has no bound The idempotency check treats any ledger record whose body has appeal_restoration == appeal_cid as the restoration, a field any signer can set, so anyone can pre-empt the restoration appeals/panel.py seeds panel selection from decision.decision_cid alone, which the deciding moderator controls and can grind to pick the panel
bug.reproduction_steps: Version in state moderation -> moderator rejects -> author appeals -> panel overturns: the version ends up listed without ever being approved Hold -> appeal -> a moderator relists then re-holds -> panel overturns: restoration overwrites the newer hold Before the panel finishes, append a signed record with body {"appeal_restoration": appeal_cid}: the overturn never restores anything
bug.expected: Restoration maps each prior state to its exact action and fails closed (no restoration, moderator notified) for unmapped states; a prior state of moderation returns the version to the moderation queue without listing it. Restoration happens only if the appealed decision is still the newest state-setting decision on the target and the version's current state is the one that decision set; otherwise it is skipped and left to a moderator. The restoration record's cid is stored on the Appeal row (idempotency by that column, not a body field); only node-authored records count. Panel seed = sha256(decision cid, appeal cid, ledger head hash at the appeal's append seq), fixed once the appeal is appended and stored on the Appeal row
bug.actual: Overturn can bypass moderation, clobber newer state, be blocked by anyone; panel is moderator-grindable

constraints.constraint: Keep panel size, majority rule and notifications unchanged
